title.narrative: Strengthening sustainable and transformative education to improve the skilled labour situation in Indonesia

The project region still suffers from structural problems that are responsible for high poverty rates among the population. Education and economic opportunities are among the relevant issues that need to be improved. A great deal can be achieved here through high-quality training.
